_comment: OKX Wallet's smart account on BNB Chain one of whose keys (an admin) is an Ethereum key whose type is OKX's EIP-191 verifier (0xd963…fe99, unpublished): the account's runtime code (OKX's 797-byte ERC-1967 proxy), OKX's implementation and the verifier, as read with eth_getCode, and the account's storage that getOwnerKeys(), validateUserOp and executeUserOp read (eth_getStorageAt), at the latest block (2026-11-19). OKX's implementation's code is BNB Chain's (one 32-byte immutable differs from OP Mainnet's, okx-passkey-verifier.json). An operation of its (0x7b5b…5ec2, block 134,520,450) with its real signature (that key's: its hash, validUntil, then a signature over the EIP-191 form of the account's digest) and the hash it signed.
